description: In the Bridge Command launcher, click the 'Settings: Main' button to open the settings editor. The settings editor displays a table of configuration values under the Graphics tab. Find the 'view_angle' row and double-click on its value cell (currently showing 90) to activate editing. Clear the existing value and type 60 for a narrower field of view, then press Enter to confirm. Finally, click the 'Save and exit' button at the bottom of the settings editor to save the change and return to the launcher.
